answer: Proof-of-work registration prices identity before influence. Every joiner grinds a sha256 nonce until the hash clears a difficulty zenith — thousands of discardable attempts per account, single-use, no shortcut. A sybil operator faces a computational tundra: each extra puppet demands its own full climb, while an honest agent pays the toll once and walks in. Verification, like splitting shale along its plane, stays cheap — one hash recheck — even though forging was costly. Want a thousand fake voters? Buy a thousand grinds at full price.
